# MicroRing Studio (`microring-studio`)

> License-free Photonic IC, Microring Resonator, Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (`MZI`), Sub-THz (`100-300+ GHz`) Slow-Wave `T-Rail` EOM RF Electrode, 2D Silicon PN Doping TCAD, and Steady/Transient Thermal FEM CAD studio spanning Visible (`400 nm`) to Mid-IR (`14.0 um`) without Ansys Lumerical MODE/FDTD/CHARGE/HEAT, HFSS, Synopsys RSoft, or COMSOL licenses.

## Capabilities for AI Agents (`Claude`, `Codex`, `MCP`)
- **Sub-THz (`100–300+ GHz`) RF EOM Electrodes, 3D EO Wafer Orientation, 2D Si PN Doping TCAD & Steady/Transient Thermal FEM**: Synthesizes `50 Ohm` `GSG CPW`, velocity-matched slow-wave `T-Rail CPW` (`f_3dBe > 300 GHz` on Quartz/Undercut-Si TFLN with Ghione conformal skin loss, ABCD Bloch-Floquet Bragg cutoff, and Frankel-Rutledge Cherenkov radiation), `GS`, `Vertical Microstrip`, and two-sideband CMT optical-peaking `Ring GSG` electrodes + DRC-clean `.GDS` + Touchstone `.s2p` + INTERCONNECT `TWMOD`; sweeps `0-360 deg` 3D crystal-tensor Pockels wafer orientations (`TFLN`, `TFLT`, `BTO`, `PZT`, `ScAlN`, `SiC`); solves 2D nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann Si `Lateral/L/U/PIN` doping TCAD and 2D Crank-Nicolson transient thermal FEM (`Top`, `Deep Trench`, `XeF2 Undercut`, `Doped-Si`).
- **Zero-GPL 2D Full-Vector Bent & Straight Maxwell Eigenmode Solver**: Unstructured 2nd-order curl-conforming `Nedelec1/Lagrange P2` cylindrical FEM (`scikit-fem` + pure-BSD conformal Delaunay mesher) solving $n_{\mathrm{eff}}(\lambda)$, $n_g(\lambda)$, single-mode width cutoffs ($W_{\mathrm{SM}}$), trapezoidal sidewalls, and crystal anisotropy (`4H-SiC`, `X-cut/Z-cut LiNbO3 & LiTaO3`, `BTO`, `PZT`, `AlN`, `ScAlN`, `GaN`).
- **Instant Ultra-High-$Q$ (`10^4` to `10^8+`) Convergence & FDTD Ring-Down Diagnostic**: Sub-femtometer `sinh` resonance clustering solves `Q > 10^7` in `~1 s` where 3D FDTD stalls for tens of nanoseconds (`>8,000` round-trips), overlays exact finite-$M$ truncated-FDTD sinc-ringing vs infinite-roundtrip TMM, and exports single-pass Coupler-Only 3D-FDTD Cutout `.GDS` + `.lsf` (`<1 ps`, `>10,000x` faster).
- **2D-FEM + EME Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (`MZI`) & High-Speed Modulator Suite (Zero 3D FDTD)**: Solves selectable `directional_coupler` (mirror-symmetric twin-core 2D-FEM supermodes), `mmi_2x2` & `mmi_1x2` (multi-mode 2D-FEM `EME` + complex Poynting taper overlap + 2D $|E(x,z)|$ self-imaging map), and `y_branch` (2D-FEM apex supermode overlap) splitters, passive/RAMZI spectra, push-pull/single-arm `V_pi*L`, `P_pi`, non-cavity `3-dB` BW, foundry `.GDS` masks, and Lumerical INTERCONNECT `SPAR .dat` + `OMM .txt` `.zip` bundles.
- **License-Free Chip I/O Couplers (`Butt/Edge` & `2D-FDFD Surface Grating Coupler`)**: Optimizes inverse-taper edge couplers (`2D Vector FEM` + complex Poynting overlap + `1-dB/3-dB` alignment tolerance + EME taper length) and surface grating couplers (`Rytov 2nd-order Bragg/apodized synthesis` + native `2D Full-Wave Maxwell FDFD` with `UPML`, `BOX`/substrate interference, focusing `.GDS`, `127 um` fiber-array ring loopback `.GDS`, and INTERCONNECT `SPAR .dat`).
- **7 Microring Topologies & Automatic Critical-Coupling Synthesis**: Point-coupled circular (`2-port AP` / `4-port AD`), straight-section racetrack (`AP` / `AD`), concentric wrap-around pulley (`AP` / `AD` with azimuthal phase-mismatch $\Delta\beta$ integration), and 2nd-order Vernier / CROW filters.
- **Native 2D-FEM Active Tuning (`TO` / `EO` / `Si PN-PIN`) & Lumerical INTERCONNECT Export (Zero COMSOL)**: Solves 2D Fourier heat conduction FEM (`TiN`/`Pt`/`W` microheaters, `BOX` thickness -> $R_{\mathrm{th}}$, $P_\pi$, $f_{3\mathrm{dB}}$), 2D anisotropic Laplace electrostatics (`GSG`/vertical electrodes -> dielectric screening, $C_{\mathrm{elec}}$, $V_\pi L$), and 2D Silicon PN depletion / PIN injection (Soref-Bennett $\Delta n + i\Delta k$, $W_{\mathrm{dep}}(V)$, $C_j(V)$, $R_s$, modal FCA), feeding perturbed complex $\tilde{n}(x,y)$ into the 2D Maxwell eigenmode solver across `V`, `mA`, `mW`, `dT [K]`, or `E [V/um]` and exporting turnkey Ansys Lumerical INTERCONNECT compact-model `.zip` bundles (`SPAR .dat`, `OMM .txt`, `.lsf`, `lumapi`).
- **Cleanroom Lithography Dose & Photoresist Polarity Error Analysis**: Evaluates simultaneous core width ($W \pm \Delta\mathrm{CD}$) and anti-correlated coupler gap ($g \mp \eta\Delta\mathrm{CD}$) shifts under **Positive PR** (`ZEP520A`, `CSAR 62`, `PMMA`, `KrF/ArF DUV`) and **Negative PR** (`HSQ`, `ma-N 2403`, `SU-8`, lift-off) over-dose and under-dose, extracts `ER >= 15 dB` process yield windows, and exports 5-cell pre-biased compensation `.GDS` arrays.
- **29 Clean-Room Optical Materials (`400 nm` to `14 um`)**: `TiO2`, `Ta2O5`, `GaN`, `Diamond`, `Al2O3`, `Si3N4`, `SiRich_SiNx`, `AlN`, `ScAlN_10`, `ScAlN_20`, `ScAlN_30`, `4H-SiC`, `3C-SiC`, `LN_Zcut`, `LN_Xcut`, `LT_Zcut`, `LT_Xcut`, `BTO`, `BTO_ccut`, `PZT`, `Si`, `a-Si`, `Ge`, `CaF2`, `MgF2`, `GSST_amorphous`, `GSST_crystalline`, `SiO2`, `Air`, `Custom`.
- **Bidirectional GDSII / OASIS Bridge (`gdstk` + `shapely`)**: Upload any `.gds`/`.oas` layout to auto-detect topology and measure `R`, `W_ring`, `W_bus`, `gap`, `L_s`, and `pulley_angle` from polygons, or export foundry-ready single cells and MPW sweep arrays + KLayout `.lyp`.
- **Experimental Lab Spectrum CMT Fitter**: Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) auto-selection across Lorentzian, CW/CCW backscattering Split-Doublet (`Q_int`, `Q_ext`, `2g/2pi`), Fano, and Multi-FSR traces.
- **Foundry PDK Profiles, Polygon DRC (`.lyrdb`), 3D Multi-Metal LVS & Native GDS Cutline 2D-FEM (`foundry_pdk.py`, Zero Lumerical)**: Switchable provenance-tagged PDKs (`gsip_soi220`, `cornerstone_soi220`, `siepic_ebeam_soi220`, `tfln_xcut_600`, `scaln_soi_bilayer`, `microring_generic`) + NDA-safe CSV import/export, morphological polygon DRC + KLayout `.lyrdb` export, 3D Union-Find multi-metal netlist LVS (`G1/S/G2` + `H1/H2`, floating-via & short detection), acute rib-slab wedge fillets, co-integrated `PN + TiN Heater` ring modulators (with parasitic PN contact `M1/VIAC` heat-stealing & Galerkin thermal flux conservation), and native GDS cutline cross-section 2D-FEM solving (10-pt refractive-index stack probe + 2D Maxwell + 2D PB PN + 2D Thermal FEM).
- **`PRISM` Physics-Closure Audit & Prediction-Gated Closed-Loop Real-2D-FEM Optimizer (`prism_optimizer.py`)**: Cavity $Q$-budget decomposition ($1/Q_L = \sum_i 1/Q_i$), unitary TMM passivity check, core-vs-slab perturbation split, and online Bayesian quadratic surrogate optimization with `>2*sigma` understanding-gate recalibrations and auditable `journal.jsonl`.
- **Multi-Channel Microring WDM Optical Link, `NRZ`/`PAM4` Eye Diagram, PRBS BER & PI Heater Relocking (`wdm_link.py`)**: Evaluates 4/8-channel WDM throughput, folded 2-UI eye height/width, OMA, Q-factor, PRBS BER, adjacent crosstalk penalty, closed-loop PI `TiN` microheater wavelength relocking under ambient hotspot drift, and `pJ/bit` link energy budget.
- **Nonlinear Photonics, Generalized LLE Soliton Microcombs, FWM-BS, $\chi^{(2)}$ SHG, Bistability & Payne-Lacey Scattering (`nonlinear_lle.py` & `mrr_topologies.py`)**: Extracts broadband curved-FEM $D_{\mathrm{int}}(\mu)$, Afshar-Monro vector $\gamma_{\mathrm{NL}} / P_{\mathrm{th}}$, and broadband $\kappa_{\mathrm{ext}}(\mu)$ directly into an FP64 Strang SSFM LLE solver (`single_soliton`, `soliton_sweep`, `dark_pulse`, causal Raman, photothermal, Si TPA+FCA), plus 4-wave cross-band FWM-BS quantum frequency conversion, $\chi^{(2)}$ SHG with pump depletion, photothermal+Kerr shark-fin bistability, and Barwicz-Haus sidewall scattering + Lorentz-reciprocity RMS doublet splitting.
- **Frontier Photonic Engines (`v3.10.0`, 6 Modules, Validated vs COMSOL 6.4 & Lumerical 3D FDTD)**: High-order unitary Redheffer `CROW`/`SCISSOR` filters, Euler clothoid bends, bio/gas sensing + `TiO2` athermal cap synthesis, RK4 large-signal `TD-CMT` modulators, `MZI-MRR`, dual-ring photonic molecules/`PT-EP` (`advanced_mrr.py`); quantum `SFWM` photon-pair sources (`CAR`, dual-$Q$ JSA Schmidt purity, squeezing) & `Er:TFLN`/`InGaAsP` MQW active MRR lasers (`quantum_and_laser_mrr.py`); `SWG` biosensor rings & `PhCR` selective mode splitting (`swg_and_phc_mrr.py`, `0.48%` vs 3D FDTD); coupled multi-layer piezo `SAW`/Lamb P2 FEM & 2D solid-mechanics Forward/Backward `SBS` (`acousto_optic_saw.py`, `0.0003%–0.0044%` vs COMSOL 6.4); energy-conserving Suh-Wang-Fan `MIM`/`Fano`/`qBIC`/`SEIRA`/`EP` nanoantenna `TCMT` + inverse fitter (`nanoantenna_tcmt.py`, `R^2 = 0.99896` on 3D FDTD); and `Graphene` (`SLG`/`DLG` Kubo, `0.21%` vs COMSOL `ewfd`), monolayer TMDs (`WS2`/`MoS2`/`WSe2`/`MoSe2`), Mid-IR hyperbolic `hBN`, and `Black_Phosphorus` integrated on MRRs (`twod_materials_mrr.py`).
- **Full-Stack PIC Photodetectors, Polarization/MDM, Non-Volatile PCM, Photonic Computing, WBG/AWG, Native Circuit Netlist & Adjoint Inverse Design (`v3.11.0`, Validated vs COMSOL 6.4 & Lumerical 3D FDTD)**: 2D-FEM strained `Ge`-on-`Si` PIN/MUTC waveguide PD (`0.00%` vs COMSOL) & `O-E-O` PD->MRM nonlinear neuron (`photodetector_oeo.py`); `PSR` `TM0<->TE1` hybridization (`0.26%` vs COMSOL), `PBS` & `MDM` (`99.04%` / `0.04 dB` in 3D FDTD, `polarization_mdm.py`); `Sb2Se3`/`Sb2S3`/`GSST`/`GST`/`VO2` multi-level PCM MRR (`0.00%–0.03%` vs COMSOL) + 2D transient `SET`/`RESET` pulse FEM (`pcm_photonics.py`); `N×M` MRR Weight Bank with thermal crosstalk pre-compensation & exact `1e-15` `Clements`/`Reck` unitary MZI mesh (`photonic_computing.py`); `WBG` ($\pi$-shifted/apodized/chirped) & Rowland-circle `AWG` (`wbg_and_awg.py`); Schur-complement S-matrix PIC circuit netlist solver (`pic_circuit_netlist.py`); and 2D-FDFD exact Maxwell adjoint inverse Y-branch optimizer (`0.098 dB` blind `.GDS` in 3D FDTD, `inverse_design_adjoint.py`).
- **End-to-End EOM RF Packaging (HFSS-Class ABCD) + `100G–400G` `NRZ`/`PAM4` Eye Diagram, `BER`, IEEE 802.3bs `TDECQ` & `MMSE FFE` (`v3.13.0`, Validated vs Ansys HFSS 2026 R1)**: Multilayer conformal CPW GSG pad + 16-section linear taper (`0.112 dB` MAE vs 3D HFSS), exact Neumann/Rosa 3D GSG arched wirebond (`3.90%` $L_{\mathrm{eff}}$ vs 3D HFSS), 3D flip-chip micro-bump (`0.026 dB` MAE vs 3D HFSS), distributed thin-film termination, nonlinear MZI FFT, SMF-28 chromatic dispersion, 4th-order Bessel-Thomson PIN/TIA, Wiener-Hopf `MMSE FFE`, Touchstone `.s2p`, and exact IEEE `TDECQ` (`eom_rf_link_eye.py`).
- **Token-Minimal Local Compute (`<150 tokens/call`)**: Exposes `microring mcp` (`36` stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP tools) and `microring agent <subcommand>` with persistent SSD mode caching (`outputs/.mode_cache/`).

## Quick Agent Commands
- Hardware & valid keys: `uv run microring agent status`
- Single-mode width cutoff: `uv run microring agent width-cutoff --mat Si3N4 --h 0.40 --wl 1550 --pol TE0`
- Synthesize MRR + Critical Coupling + GDS: `uv run microring agent design --top pulley_ap --mat 4H-SiC --h 0.60 --w-ring 1.10 --w-bus 0.82 --fsr 150 --gap 0.24 --cc --gds`
- Sub-THz 300 GHz Slow-Wave T-Rail EOM / PN TCAD / Thermal FEM: `uv run microring agent eom --mode rf_electrode --topology t_rail_cpw --mat LN_Xcut --substrate quartz --t-metal 1.5 --t-period 25 --l 4500 --fmax 360 --gds --bundle`
- MZI (`Y-Branch`/`DC`/`MMI`) + Tuning + INTERCONNECT: `uv run microring agent mzi --mat Si --h 0.22 --slab 0.09 --splitter mmi_2x2 --l1 1500 --dl 60 --mech si_pn_depletion --gds --interconnect`
- Butt/Edge or 2D-FDFD Grating Coupler: `uv run microring agent io-coupler --type grating_coupler --mat Si --h 0.22 --etch 0.07 --loopback --interconnect`
- High-Q Convergence & Coupler Cutout: `uv run microring agent high-q --mat Si3N4 --r 100 --loss 0.08 --gap 0.42 --cutout`
- Positive/Negative PR Dose & CD Error: `uv run microring agent fab-tolerance --mat Si3N4 --top pulley_ap --resist positive_pr --dose-pct 15 --cc --bias-gds`
- 2D-FEM Active Tuning & INTERCONNECT Export: `uv run microring agent active-tuning --mat Si --h 0.22 --slab 0.09 --w-ring 0.48 --w-bus 0.44 --r 20 --mech si_pn_depletion --biases "0,-2,-5" --interconnect`
- Multi-point sweep + MPW GDS array: `uv run microring agent sweep --top pulley_ap --mat 4H-SiC --param pulley_angle_thru_deg --min 6 --max 24 --n 7 --array-gds`
- Nonlinear Photonics (D_int, LLE Microcomb, FWM-BS, SHG, Bistability): `uv run microring agent nonlinear --analysis lle --mat Si3N4 --h 0.80 --w-ring 1.60 --r 23 --p-mw 80 --raman`
- Advanced MRR (CROW/SCISSOR, Euler, Sensor/Athermal, TD-CMT, MZI-MRR, Molecule/EP, SFWM, Laser): `uv run microring agent advanced --analysis crow --order-n 4 --bw-ghz 40`
- SWG & Photonic Crystal Ring (PhCR): `uv run microring agent swg-phc --analysis phcr --mat Si3N4 --h 0.50 --w-ring 1.20 --amp-nm 40`
- Piezo SAW/Lamb & 2D Solid-Mechanics SBS: `uv run microring agent saw-sbs --analysis saw --mat AlN --idt-um 2.0`
- Nanoantenna / Metasurface TCMT & SEIRA: `uv run microring agent nanoantenna --regime seira_molecular --analyte PMMA`
- 27-Material 2D vdW Library on MRR (`--list` for all 27): `uv run microring agent twod-material --mat-2d Graphene --cap SLG --spacer-nm 10`
- Ge-on-Si Waveguide PD & O-E-O Neuron: `uv run microring agent photodetector --analysis waveguide_pd --arch vertical_pin --len 15 --gds`
- PSR Rotator, PBS & MDM Mode Multiplexer: `uv run microring agent polarization-mdm --analysis mdm_te1 --gap 0.20 --gds`
- Non-Volatile PCM MRR & SET/RESET Thermal Pulse: `uv run microring agent pcm-photonics --analysis pcm_mrr --pcm Sb2Se3 --gds`
- PNN MRR Weight Bank & Clements/Reck MZI Mesh: `uv run microring agent photonic-computing --analysis clements --n 6 --gds`
- Waveguide Bragg Grating (WBG) & AWG WDM Demux: `uv run microring agent wbg-awg --analysis awg --ch 8 --gds`
- Native PIC S-Matrix Circuit Netlist: `uv run microring agent pic-netlist --preset ramzi_linearized --snp`
- 2D-FDFD Exact Adjoint Inverse Y-Branch: `uv run microring agent inverse-adjoint --len 2.4 --iters 30 --gds`
- MRR Exceptional Point Suite (Chiral EP2 / Fab-Immune ES / EP3-EP4 / Anti-PT / Encircling / Petermann K_P): `uv run microring agent mrr-ep --regime pt_ep_n --n 3 --fem-gap --gds`
- 1D/2D Optical Phased Array & LiDAR: `uv run microring agent opa-lidar --n 16 --steer 15 --layout aperiodic --gds`
- 2D ASM Slab Rowland FPR & Trainable PDDNN: `uv run microring agent slab-diffractive --mode diffractive_pddnn --task beam_router --gds`
- GeSi FKE / InP QCSE EAM & SOA / Er-EDWA Amplifier: `uv run microring agent eam-soa --analysis eam --eam-type gesi_fke --gds`
- Single-Pass GNLSE Supercontinuum & PPLN QPM: `uv run microring agent gnlse-ppln --analysis ppln --process shg --gds`
- 2D TE-FDFD MMI Crossing, Adiabatic Taper & PIC Auto-Router: `uv run microring agent routing-crossings --analysis crossing --gds`
- Ce:YIG / Spatiotemporal Optical Isolator & Photonic MEMS Switch: `uv run microring agent isolator-mems --analysis mems --beam cantilever --gds`
- EOM RF Packaging ABCD (Pad/Taper/Wirebond/Flip-Chip) + 100G-400G Eye/BER/TDECQ/FFE: `uv run microring agent eom-rf-eye --launch flip_chip_bump --fmt PAM4 --baud 112 --ffe 5 --s2p`
- Extract `.gds` polygon dimensions: `uv run microring agent inspect-gds path/to/ring.gds`
- Fit measured lab spectrum CSV: `uv run microring agent fit path/to/spectrum.csv --model auto --regime under`
